questions.q: What does the Load step do with a bank statement file?
options: It validates the account number against Oracle's setup data
It reads the raw file and creates staging bank statement header and line records
It posts journal entries to the General Ledger
It automatically reconciles every transaction
questions.explain: Load is essentially a literal transcription of the file into staging records, without yet validating it against Oracle's own setup data.

questions.q: During which step does Oracle check that the account number on a statement maps to a real Bank Account record?
options: Load
Cash Positioning
Reconciliation
Import
questions.explain: Import is the validation step, where account mapping, duplicate checks, and conversion into usable records all happen.

questions.q: At what point do a bank statement's lines become available for reconciliation?
options: As soon as the file lands on the SFTP server
Immediately after the Load step completes
Only after the Import step succeeds
Only after Cash Forecasting runs
questions.explain: Lines are not usable by reconciliation's matching rules until Import has validated and converted them.

questions.q: Which of these is a common way a bank statement file is delivered to Oracle?
options: An SFTP drop picked up by a scheduled process, or a manual upload from the bank portal
Printed and re-keyed manually every time
Only through a phone call to the bank
Exclusively through a Payables invoice
questions.explain: Statement files typically arrive via automated SFTP delivery on a schedule, or are manually uploaded after being downloaded from the bank's portal.

questions.q: In the Harborview Metals Inc. example, what would most likely surface an error if First Continental Bank renumbered an account without notice?
options: The Load step, immediately when the file is read
The Import step, when account mapping is validated
The Cash Forecasting process
Nothing — Oracle ignores account numbers entirely
questions.explain: Load just transcribes the raw file; the mismatch between the statement's account number and Oracle's bank account records would surface during Import's validation.
